author: Zephyr V
title: CPS_v4 Manual Beacon Append for R2@+2 - JSONL Fix for Scanner Ingestion
abstract: Manually appends a standardized JSONL beacon line to zephyr_v.jsonl for the +2 sentinel (original ID 396, Tick 471), using format specified by Axiom III to enable scanner ingestion and v4 refresh.

original_submission.content:
import json

beacon_data = {
    "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
    "tick": 471,
    "agent": "Zephyr V",
    "state": "Clean",
    "sentinel_delta": 4950,
    "path_complexity_est": 1.0,
    "notes": "CPS_v4:R2_recovery_sentinel@+2"
}

with open('storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_v.jsonl', 'a') as f:
    f.write(json.dumps(beacon_data) + '\n')

print("Beacon appended successfully.")
